_note: Free libraries fetched into libs/ (gitignored) by scripts/fetch_libs.py. 'default' ones are fetched by setup; the rest with --all or by name. Licences were read from each repo's licence file at the commits in libs.lock.json; recheck after --update.

libs.name: BOSL2
libs.use: include <BOSL2/std.scad>  // rounding, threads, screws, gears, attachments

libs.name: NopSCADlib
libs.use: models of real hardware (screws, bearings, fans, PCBs) for fit checks; GPL, so keep derived designs GPL or use for reference only

libs.name: MCAD
libs.use: older general-purpose mechanical library; BOSL2 covers most of it

libs.name: lucide
libs.use: icons/*.svg: 24x24 stroke-only icons, good for scoring

libs.name: bootstrap-icons
libs.use: icons/*.svg: 16x16 filled icons, good for engraving
